ouroboros.contracts.v1.ByteInterval.json.description: ByteInterval is a half-open raw-byte interval [start_byte, end_byte).

endByte.description: end_byte is exclusive and must be >= start_byte.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ByteInterval.json.title: Byte Interval

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.LineInterval.json.description: LineInterval is a half-open one-based line interval [start_line, end_line).

endLine.description: end_line is exclusive and must be >= start_line.

startLine.description: start_line is inclusive and one-based when non-zero.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.LineInterval.json.title: Line Interval

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TracerLogicalPari.description:
TracerLogicalParityProjection is the canonical comparison tuple for local vs
 Modal VERIFY_TRACER_EVIDENCE_SHARD_V1 receipts. Any difference is
 REMOTE_RECEIPT_MISMATCH. Realm, run/attempt/lease/fence IDs, times, host
 metrics, and cleanup receipts are intentionally excluded.

anchorDigest.description: anchor_digest is the recomputed anchor digest.

inputBundleDigest.description: input_bundle_digest binds the full immutable input bundle.

operationVersion.description: operation_version pins the deterministic operation implementation version.

outputDigest.description: output_digest binds the full logical output.

resultCode.description: result_code is the deterministic shard result.
resultCode.title: Tracer Shard Result Code

shardId.description: shard_id is the fixed shard identity.

sourceArtifactDigest.description: source_artifact_digest pins the validated source artifact.

sourceByteLength.description: source_byte_length is the validated source byte count.

sourceRevision.description: source_revision is the source revision digest hex binding.

spanByteInterval.description: span_byte_interval is the validated supporting-span byte interval.

spanDigest.description: span_digest is the recomputed span digest.

spanLineInterval.description: span_line_interval is the validated supporting-span line interval.

tracerManifestDigest.description: tracer_manifest_digest binds the projection to one TracerManifest.

validatedFileCount.description: validated_file_count is the number of source files validated.

validatedSpanCount.description: validated_span_count is the number of spans validated.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.TracerLogicalPari.title: Tracer Logical Parity Projection
